honest_access_summary: PDS requires a free Research Access account + signed DUA; dataset IDs are assigned inside the portal per deposit and are not enumerable from the public catalog without login. The NCT + sponsor identifiers above are the stable public handles to locate each deposit; the ingestion script (W5) authenticates with user-supplied PDS credentials and pulls the CA-125 + outcome tables once the DUA is active. No CA-125 patient data was downloaded in this discovery step.
